notes: Cash basis village; governmental funds from the p4 Total column, proprietary (Water, Sewer, Trash) from the p6 Total column (cash basis, measure cash). Taxes 286,505 split by the Statement of Activities tax rows (p2, adds exactly); Miscellaneous lines split into Insurance Proceeds and Other Miscellaneous Receipts from the p2 governmental / business-type columns (each adds exactly). Detail: major governmental funds from the p4 fund columns, nonmajor funds from the p8 combining statement, utility funds from the p6 fund columns; the all-funds budget schedule (p7) is not recorded (combined, less detailed). Component unit (Verdigre Library Foundation) excluded. Read pages 1-8 of 8
